resources.string: Use only a Wi-Fi network you trust. This connection uses unencrypted HTTP: people on the network may see files, audio and pairing tokens. Device names and fingerprints do not prove identity.
Nothing listens or records until you start it. Leaving the screen or backgrounding stops all LAN tools. Returning never restarts them automatically.
Your listening port (0 chooses a free port)
Enter a private numeric IPv4 address and valid ports. Public addresses and hostnames are not supported.
Listener stopped. Incoming files and audio are not accepted.
Could not start listening. Check Wi-Fi and choose a different listening port.

Share this receiving token privately with the peer at the address above. Paste their token below. Tokens change whenever listening restarts and expire after 15 minutes. Stop before changing peer addresses.
Microphone permission was denied. No audio is recorded.

After granting permission, start listening and hold again. Audio is sent only while held, at most 15 seconds. Release, scroll away, lose focus or background to stop. A focused hardware Space or Enter key also works while held.
Talk stopped. Check microphone permission, peer address, listening port and current pairing token.
The peer did not accept the selected file.
Send failed or was declined. Check the peer address and port; the receiver must explicitly start listening and accept within 25 seconds.
File could not be opened, saved or deleted. Choose a regular file with a known size, no larger than 25 MiB.
Accept only if you expect these files. The sender name is unverified. This offer expires after 25 seconds. Nothing is downloaded before acceptance.
File received into the private inbox.
The inbox has no room for this offer. Delete received files, then ask the sender to try again.

Files remain in this app until you delete them. Save a copy to a folder you choose. The inbox holds at most 32 files and 100 MiB; delete files to make room. Picking or saving a document may stop the listener.
Copy saved. The original remains in the private inbox.
